topArticle.description:
A girl called Àìná was captured by an African king and later taken to England to become Sarah Forbes Bonetta, protege of the imperial monarch 
When she was seven years old, Bayo Randle’s great-great-grandmother Sarah Forbes Bonetta was presented to Queen Victoria at Windsor Castle as a “diplomatic gift” from an African king.
Victoria would go on to pay for Bonetta’s education, approve her marriage to one of west Africa’s wealthiest men, and become godmother to her eldest daughter.

topArticle.title: LGBTQ+ people go into hiding in Senegal as hundreds are arrested
topArticle.description:
At least 320 people detained for ‘acts against nature’ after law criminalising homosexuality toughened, HRW reports
Mass arrests, forced HIV testing and barriers to legal representation are part of an escalating crackdown against LGBTQ+ people in Senegal, according to a new report.
More than 320 individuals have been arrested and detained on allegations of “acts against nature” since February, according to HIV Justice Network, an organisation quoted in the Human Rights Watch (HRW) report. Among these, at least 84 were charged with “voluntary HIV transmission”, solely on the basis of their HIV status.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: セネガルでLGBTQ+の人々が数百人逮捕され、潜伏へ

topArticle.title: Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza denies using AI to write prize-winning story
topArticle.description:
Article in Atlantic claims The Blue Fighter was artificially generated, days after it won Caine prize for African writers
The Zimbabwean writer Simbarashe Kundizeza has denied using AI to write a prize-winning short story after an article in the Atlantic said software had flagged it as almost completely AI-generated.
Kundizeza’s story The Blue Fighter was announced as the winner of the prestigious Caine prize for African writers on 6 October. Five days later, The Atlantic published an article by the author and journalist Vauhini Vara titled: “Yet Another Literary prize winner Seems to Be AI.”

topArticle.title: Guinea-Bissau denies it has approved controversial vaccine trial in newborns

Health minister says government ‘did not authorize’ Danish-led hepatitis B trial in babies backed by RFK Jr
Guinea-Bissau has not approved the controversial hepatitis B study in newborns that would be funded by the US government and private partners, the African country’s minister of health said on Tuesday.
The study, which would not investigate the safety or effectiveness of vaccines but would instead track “nonspecific” health outcomes like overall mortality or neurodevelopmental conditions, has been championed by Robert F Kennedy Jr, secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and a longtime anti-vaccine activist.

topArticle.title: ‘4,000 people minding our own business’: four decades on, Falklands again face a hostile Argentina
topArticle.description:
Facing a slump in the polls, Argentina’s president is making economic attacks on the islands’ oil industry, and suggesting its key fisheries industry could be next 
A dozen local people and a uniformed military police officer (“Do you mind if I sit in?”) took their seats at the back of the handsome wood-panelled courtroom that doubles as the Falkland Islands’ legislative assembly. Outside, it was a typically blowy early evening. It may nominally be spring in the south Atlantic, but Stanley harbour, with its dark grey water speckled with historical shipwrecks, was a cauldron of swells and churn.
Six of the assembly’s eight members – five men, one woman – waited patiently at a row of desks and microphones. The heating had been turned up to just short of uncomfortable. Behind them, a portrait of King Charles. From the other walls, dusty photographs of governors, of varying popularity, gazed disinterestedly at the scene.
 Continue reading...

topArticle.summary: アゼルバイジャンで、学校でのヘッドスカーフ禁止が稀な抗議運動を引き起こし、トルコとの間で論争となっている。

topArticle.title: Maduro pleads not guilty to new torture-related charges in New York
topArticle.description: "I reject this document entirely," Maduro said in court, responding to newly added torture-related charges.
topArticle.titleJa: マドゥロ大統領、ニューヨークでの新たな拷問関連容疑に無罪を主張
topArticle.summary: マドゥロ大統領がニューヨークで拷問関連の新たな容疑について無罪を主張。法廷で文書を完全に拒否したと述べた。

topArticle.title: Pope walking and recovering 'as expected' after surgery, doctors say
topArticle.description: The 71-year-old Pope was diagnosed with lung cancer after the 90-minute procedure on Tuesday.
topArticle.titleJa: ローマ教皇、手術後「順調に」回復中と医師団が発表
topArticle.summary: 医師団によると、71歳のローマ教皇は火曜日の90分間の手術後、肺がんを診断されたが、「順調に」歩行し回復している。

topArticle.title: Argentina targets UK in legal claim over Falklands oil exploration
topArticle.description: The action filed with an international maritime tribunal is the latest development in an escalating row over the Falkland Islands.
topArticle.titleJa: アルゼンチン、フォークランド諸島での石油探査巡り英国を提訴
topArticle.summary: 国際海洋裁判所に提訴されたこの訴訟は、フォークランド諸島を巡る紛争激化の最新の動きである。

topArticle.title: Film shares 'rich tapestry' of Windrush children's lives
topArticle.description: The stories of seven people whose parents are from the Windrush generation are told in a new film.
topArticle.titleJa: 映画が「ウィンドラッシュ世代の子どもたち」の豊かな人生の物語を共有
topArticle.summary: 新しい映画で、ウィンドラッシュ世代の親を持つ7人の人生の物語が語られ、彼らの豊かな人生のタペストリーが共有される。

topArticle.title: Peru’s Indigenous people in Cutivireni and Oviri take the front line against Amazon wildfires
topArticle.description: As El Niño worsens dry conditions, Peru’s indigenous people in Cutivireni and Oviri are taking action to protect their Amazon territory from wildfires.
topArticle.titleJa: ペルーの先住民がアマゾンの森林火災に対し最前線で立ち向かう
topArticle.summary: エルニーニョ現象による乾燥が深刻化する中、ペルーのクティヴィレニとオヴィリに住む先住民が、アマゾン領土を森林火災から守るために行動を起こしている。

topArticle.title: How Ecuador is fighting to keep industrial trans fats off the food shelf
topArticle.description: As health advocates push for tighter controls, Ecuador confronts the gap between regulating trans fats and enforcing those rules.
topArticle.titleJa: エクアドルが工業用トランス脂肪酸を食品棚から排除するためにどのように闘っているか
topArticle.summary: エクアドルでは、保健推進派が工業用トランス脂肪酸に対するより厳格な規制を求めており、国は規制と施行の間のギャップに直面している。

topArticle.title: 'Onion cartel' in Philippines fined $28m for price shock
topArticle.description: Onions were worth more than the daily minimum wage at the height of the price surge in 2022.
topArticle.titleJa: フィリピンの「タマネギカルテル」が価格高騰で2800万ドルの罰金
topArticle.summary: 2022年の価格高騰時、タマネギの価格が最低日給を上回ったため、フィリピンの「タマネギカルテル」に2800万ドルの罰金が科された。

topArticle.title: At the scene of a school roof collapse in Pakistan
topArticle.description: At least 33 pupils and a teacher were killed according to hospital officials, and more than a dozen were injured.
topArticle.titleJa: パキスタンでの学校屋根崩落現場にて
topArticle.summary: パキスタンの学校の屋根崩落事故現場で、病院関係者によると少なくとも生徒33人と教師1人が死亡し、十数人が負傷した。

topArticle.title: Australian woman charged with lacing colleague's curry with snail poison
topArticle.description: The alleged victim, who was in a relationship with the woman, had spotted bright green pellets in the meal.
topArticle.titleJa: オーストラリア人女性、同僚のカレーにカタツムリ毒を混入した容疑で起訴
topArticle.summary: オーストラリアで、ある女性が、恋人関係にあった同僚のカレーに明るい緑色のペレット（カタツムリ毒）を混入したとして起訴された。

topArticle.title: Desperate to clear toxic haze, Indonesia douses its skies with dry ice
topArticle.description: Authorities in South East Asia have turned to weather modification as fires blanket the region in smog.
topArticle.titleJa: 有毒な煙霧を晴らすため、インドネシアが空にドライアイスを散布
topArticle.summary: 東南アジアの当局は、地域を覆う煙霧を晴らすため、天候改変技術としてドライアイスを空に散布し、有毒な霞を取り除こうとしている。

topArticle.title: North Korea and China open new bridge after 12-year delay
topArticle.description: China is the North's largest trading partner and a lifeline against the sanctions Pyongyang faces.
topArticle.titleJa: 北朝鮮と中国、12年の遅延を経て新橋を開通
topArticle.summary: 北朝鮮と中国が12年の遅延を経て新たな橋を開通させた。中国は北朝鮮最大の貿易相手国であり、制裁下にある北朝鮮にとっての生命線である。

topArticle.title: Talks kick off for Timor-Leste's accession to government procurement pact
topArticle.description: At a meeting of the Committee on Government Procurement on 14 October, parties to the Government Procurement Agreement (GPA) 2012 welcomed Timor-Leste's submission of key documents required to kick off its negotiations on acceding to the Agreement. The Committee also reviewed regulatory developments, heard updates on the accession process of other members, and for the first time conducted a dialogue with the private sector on the significance of the Agreement in a changing trade environment.
topArticle.titleJa: 東ティモールの政府調達協定加盟に向けた協議が開始
topArticle.summary: 東ティモールが政府調達協定への加盟交渉を開始するための重要書類を提出し、委員会で歓迎された。民間部門との対話も行われた。

topArticle.title: Madagascar launches safeguard investigation on certain confectionary
topArticle.description: On 12 October 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of sugar confectionary as well as chocolate and cocoa confectionary.
topArticle.titleJa: マダガスカルが特定の菓子類に対するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: マダガスカルは、砂糖菓子およびチョコレート・ココア菓子の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。
